mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline >0.25pp over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.0% for two consecutive months signals restrictive policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods with FEDFUNDS >3.0% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal (UNRATE decline >0.1pp and PAYEMS rise >50k) fails to predict positive returns in >50% of instances over 3-year rolling windows, or Rank IC <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, rising HOUST and INDPRO indicate robust demand and supply chain strength, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns negative in >50% of late-cycle expansion periods with HOUST/INDPRO above 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining UNRATE over 3 months indicates labor market strength that supports consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >50% of periods with UNRATE decline >0.2pp over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 5.5% for two consecutive months signals economic weakness that reduces earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns positive in >50% of periods with UNRATE >5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising INDPRO over 3 months indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns negative in >50% of periods with INDPRO rise >0.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising RSAFS over 3 months reflects strong consumer demand that boosts corporate revenues and stock valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns negative in >50% of periods with RSAFS rise >0.3% over 3 months, or Rank IC <0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.
